problem: Personal LinkedIn fallback source-level dedupe was active in production inside powerhouse_prepare_daily_content_fallbacks_v1, but the complete function definition was absent from canonical migration history. Clean Supabase replay therefore had no function to patch.
root_cause: A direct production recovery created/modified powerhouse_prepare_daily_content_fallbacks_v1 outside replayable Git history, while stale PR #2569 captured only a delta against that hidden runtime baseline.
prevention: Canonical Git must contain the full runtime function definition, not only a patch that assumes hidden production state.
Fallback selection must exclude any content_id already used by an earlier linkedin_personal recommendation.
Security-definer runtime functions must preserve explicit search_path and revoke anon/authenticated EXECUTE while granting service_role only.
Hosted Supabase Preview must replay from zero before runtime parity is considered restored.
failed_approaches: Leaving a direct production function hotfix outside canonical Git.
Applying a text patch to a function that did not exist on clean replay.
